Name: Parmenas
Summary: Parmenas was one of the seven men chosen to serve tables in the Jerusalem church. Acts names him among the seven and records nothing further of him by name.
KeyStory: Parmenas was chosen with the seven, men of honest report, full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom.
LifeLesson: A church that feeds its widows fairly needs honest hands. Parmenas was one of them.
